name: Inline stat chart
purpose: Two purely decorative CSS/DOM charts used as card visuals on the Home 'Scale with confidence' section. Neither is an image asset.

volumeBars.note: 36 ascending-noise bars in a 291x128 chart on a #fafafa panel, gradient-filled bottom-to-top, with a 'Volume' label above
volumeBars.opacityNote: opacity is 1 — the muted look comes from the gradient's own desaturated colors, not a 0.4 overlay. Recorded as an explicit correction in the source.

uptimeBars.note: two right-aligned rows (API, MCP) of 28 solid 6x20 olive bars each

accessibility.note: both are aria-hidden in the source — decorative, with the real claim carried by the card title text
